name: uma-ad
description: Motion-graphics explainer for the Uma app, built with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render UmaExplainer out/uma-explainer.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 && remotion render UmaExplainerVertical out/uma-explainer-vertical.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18 && npm run finish
scripts.finish: ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/uma-explainer.mp4 -vf 'scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p' -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -movflags +faststart -an out/uma-explainer.tmp.mp4 && mv out/uma-explainer.tmp.mp4 out/uma-explainer.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/uma-explainer-vertical.mp4 -vf 'scale=in_range=full:out_range=tv,format=yuv420p' -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -movflags +faststart -an out/uma-explainer-vertical.tmp.mp4 && mv out/uma-explainer-vertical.tmp.mp4 out/uma-explainer-vertical.mp4
